ambiguities.source_text: Find each team member's annual salary
ambiguities.ref: month_cols = [str(i) for i in range(1, 13)]; df["Salary"] = df[month_cols].sum(axis=1)
ambiguities.intent: Sum months 1 through 12 on the retained row; missing columns or nonnumeric monthly values contribute zero.

ambiguities.source_text: Find each team member's maximum tax band based on their annual salary
ambiguities.intent: Salary >125140 maps to 45% rate; else >50270 to 40% rate; otherwise 20% rate.

ambiguities.source_text: Work out how much tax an individual paid for each of the % bands.
ambiguities.intent: Apply only the simplified bands given in this task: 20% of the portion above 12570 up to 50270; 40% above 50270 up to 125140; 45% above 125140.
Keep 40% rate paid blank unless salary exceeds 50270, and 45% rate tax paid blank unless it exceeds 125140. The 20% field is always populated.
ambiguities.source_text: Leave `40% rate paid` blank/null when Salary does not exceed £50,270, and leave `45% rate tax paid` blank/null when Salary does not exceed £125,140.

ambiguities.intent: Treat blank bands as zero only when summing Total Tax Paid.

ambiguities.source_text: Find the latest row (largest row number) to capture the individuals correct salary information
ambiguities.intent: Use the last row in original file order per StaffID.
